workOrder.summary: Add edit affordances to Dashboard (TodayLessonCard via DoToday) and Schedule (ScheduleTimeline). TodayLessonCard: add optional onEditLesson?: (id: string) => void prop. When provided, render a lucide Pencil icon button (aria-label='Edit lesson') on each lesson row (alongside the existing mark-done/skip buttons). DoToday (features/dashboard/front/components/DoToday.tsx): import useRouter from next/navigation, pass onEditLesson={id => router.push('/lessons?editId=' + id)} to TodayLessonCard. ScheduleTimeline (features/schedule/front/components/ScheduleTimeline.tsx): in TimelineRow, when entry.kind === 'lesson', add a Pencil icon button that calls useRouter().push('/lessons?editId=' + entry.lesson.id). Place it inside the existing right-side content area alongside StatusPill, keeping existing data-testid attributes unchanged.
